title: Valuation and readiness
body: Normalise financials, agree a price range, fix what buyers will flag.

title: Teaser and info memo
body: Anonymous teaser first, full memorandum after NDA.

title: Buyer outreach
body: Curated list of strategics, PE and private buyers, approached in parallel.

title: Offers and negotiation
body: Compare offers on price, structure and certainty. Sign a term sheet.

title: Due diligence and close
body: Manage the data room, lawyers and SPA through to completion.
